description: The Renovate preset every Paddock app extends: `local>decryp7/paddock//renovate/app` (plan X27). One weekly PR for ordinary updates, security fixes at any time, the decryp7 crates and packages in one PR per Paddock release, shared CI actions pinned by tag.

packageRules.description: One weekly PR for every non-security update; security fixes come as their own PRs at any time
Paddock crates and packages (registry decryp7, scope @decryp7) move together: one PR per Paddock release (ADR 0012 section 8)
Paddock's shared CI actions and workflows are pinned by release tag, not by digest (plan D7)
Gitea Actions only supports v3 of the artifact actions
Node follows app/.nvmrc, which CI and the host runners must match; bump it by hand
